label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
**Subject: Sunbelt Charter Coaches: no-show buses and no communication, Thurs Nov 5**

I'm posting this so you have the facts before booking Sunbelt for airport or offsite runs, especially during CES season.

I booked Sunbelt for a client dinner last Thursday, Nov 5. We had 220 guests, with pickups at the hotel at 6:15 for an offsite at a ranch venue in Henderson. We reserved 4 coaches, and Sunbelt confirmed in writing twice, most recently on Tuesday, Nov 3. The total was $8,400. I paid the 50% deposit in September and the balance 7 days out.

On the night, only 2 coaches arrived. The first came 55 minutes late. The driver told us he had been given the assignment at 5:00 that afternoon. The second coaches never showed. The bus that did come later broke down on the 215 with the AC out, and guests sat on the shoulder for about 40 minutes.

To get people to dinner, I put about 60 guests into Ubers and Lyfts on my company card, for roughly $1,900. Because of the delays, dinner started at 8:40 instead of 7:00, and the caterer charged us overtime.

The dispatcher on all our confirmations was Corey. His office line has gone to voicemail since Friday, and I have not received a response to my refund request. I am asking for a refund of the two coaches that never arrived and reimbursement for the rideshare costs.

I want to be fair about this. One late bus I could understand. What I can't accept is having no backup plan and no communication when the problem was obvious. Sunbelt did well on two small airport runs for me last spring, which is part of why I trusted them with something this size.

This also affects my client relationship. They are now reviewing whether to keep us for their March event, and that decision traces back to Sunbelt's failure to deliver.

My advice: if you have a large event coming up, confirm your bookings with Sunbelt directly, ask who your dispatcher is and what their after-hours contact is, and get a backup plan in writing. I would not rely on them for anything large until they can show they have fixed dispatch.

Happy to share the confirmation emails and receipts with anyone who wants to see them.
